subject: Charter Amendments and School Committee Leadership
overview: The Governance Committee concluded its substantive review of the Charter Study Committee's recommendations, passing several amendments that alter the proposed power structure and citizen participation mechanisms. The committee notably voted to remove the Mayor as the Chair of the School Committee and to limit recall provisions to the mayoral office.

items.title: Article 4: School Committee Leadership and Composition
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the draft charter to maintain the Mayor as a voting member of the School Committee but remove the Mayor from the position of Chair. The committee also discussed ward versus district representation for the body without taking formal action.

items.title: School Committee Organization and Prohibitions
items.summary: Approved several motions to standardize internal organization, including shifting agenda-setting authority to the Chair and striking a provision that allowed members to return to vacated city positions immediately after service. The committee also voted to fix clerical errors and requested legal clarification regarding the body’s hiring authority versus that of the Superintendent.

items.title: Article 8: Group Petitions and Participation Thresholds
items.summary: Approved renaming 'Free Petitions' to 'Group Petitions' and raising the signature threshold from 25 to 100 voters while adding a requirement for legal review of petition topics. The committee also aligned the signature thresholds for both citizen initiatives and referendums at 15%.

items.title: Recall Provisions and Ineligible Measures
items.summary: Approved a motion to limit the recall provision exclusively to the office of the Mayor, removing it for two-year terms for the City Council and School Committee. The committee further amended the charter to clarify that no portion of the city or school budget is subject to citizen initiatives or referendums.

items.title: Article 9: Periodic Charter Review and General Provisions
items.summary: Approved changing the composition of the periodic Charter Review Committee to ensure equal appointments by the Mayor, City Council, and School Committee. Technical amendments were also adopted to refine the definitions of city agencies and the school system within the charter.

items.title: Compensation of Elected Officials
items.summary: A proposal to set specific salary amounts and percentages for elected officials directly within the charter was discussed but ultimately withdrawn. Members debated tying salary increases to the settlement of collective bargaining agreements for city unions.

items.title: Final Referral and Adjournment
items.summary: Referred all articles as amended to the Committee of the Whole and directed the production of final redline versions for further review. The meeting was adjourned after more than five hours of deliberation.
